spec: Implement module pulse_div4(input wire clk, rst, en, output reg pulse). All state changes only on rising clk. rst is active-high synchronous and has priority. State before the first reset edge is unspecified. Internal counter initially 0 on reset. Each enabled edge increments modulo 4. pulse=1 on an enabled edge whose old counter was 3, otherwise pulse=0 (including disabled edges). Disabled edges hold counter, not pulse.
